verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِعَبْدِ ٱلرَّبِّ دَاوُدَ ٱلَّذِي كَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبَّ بِكَلَامِ هَذَا ٱلنَّشِيدِ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلَّذِي أَنْقَذَهُ فِيهِ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنْ أَيْدِي كُلِّ أَعْدَائِهِ وَمِنْ يَدِ شَاوُلَ. فَقَالَ: أُحِبُّكَ يَارَبُّ، يَا قُوَّتِي.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David, the servant of the LORD, who spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day [that] the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: And he said, I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ صَخْرَتِي وَحِصْنِي وَمُنْقِذِي. إِلَهِي صَخْرَتِي بِهِ أَحْتَمِي. تُرْسِي وَقَرْنُ خَلَاصِي وَمَلْجَإِي.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, [and] my high tower.
verses.web: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

verses.ar: أَدْعُو ٱلرَّبَّ ٱلْحَمِيدَ، فَأَتَخَلَّصُ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي.
verses.kjv: I will call upon the LORD, [who is worthy] to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.web: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

verses.ar: اِكْتَنَفَتْنِي حِبَالُ ٱلْمَوْتِ، وَسُيُولُ ٱلْهَلَاكِ أَفْزَعَتْنِي.
verses.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.web: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

verses.ar: حِبَالُ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ حَاقَتْ بِي. أَشْرَاكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱنْتَشَبَتْ بِي.
verses.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.web: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

verses.ar: فِي ضِيقِي دَعَوْتُ ٱلرَّبَّ، وَإِلَى إِلَهِي صَرَخْتُ، فَسَمِعَ مِنْ هَيْكَلِهِ صَوْتِي، وَصُرَاخِي قُدَّامَهُ دَخَلَ أُذُنَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, [even] into his ears.
verses.web: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

verses.ar: فَٱرْتَجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱرْتَعَشَتْ، أُسُسُ ٱلْجِبَالِ ٱرْتَعَدَتْ وَٱرْتَجَّتْ لِأَنَّهُ غَضِبَ.
verses.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

verses.ar: صَعِدَ دُخَانٌ مِنْ أَنْفِهِ، وَنَارٌ مِنْ فَمِهِ أَكَلَتْ. جَمْرٌ ٱشْتَعَلَتْ مِنْهُ.
verses.kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.web: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

verses.ar: طَأْطَأَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَنَزَلَ، وَضَبَابٌ تَحْتَ رِجْلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness [was] under his feet.
verses.web: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

verses.ar: رَكِبَ عَلَى كَرُوبٍ وَطَارَ، وَهَفَّ عَلَى أَجْنِحَةِ ٱلرِّيَاحِ.
verses.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.web: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

verses.ar: جَعَلَ ٱلظُّلْمَةَ سِتْرَهُ. حَوْلَهُ مِظَلَّتَهُ ضَبَابَ ٱلْمِيَاهِ وَظَلَامَ ٱلْغَمَامِ.
verses.kjv: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him [were] dark waters [and] thick clouds of the skies.
verses.web: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلشُّعَاعِ قُدَّامَهُ عَبَرَتْ سُحُبُهُ. بَرَدٌ وَجَمْرُ نَارٍ.
verses.kjv: At the brightness [that was] before him his thick clouds passed, hail [stones] and coals of fire.
verses.web: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

verses.ar: أَرْعَدَ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، وَٱلْعَلِيُّ أَعْطَى صَوْتَهُ، بَرَدًا وَجَمْرَ نَارٍ.
verses.kjv: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail [stones] and coals of fire.
verses.web: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ سِهَامَهُ فَشَتَّتَهُمْ، وَبُرُوقًا كَثِيرَةً فَأَزْعَجَهُمْ،
verses.kjv: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.web: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

verses.ar: فَظَهَرَتْ أَعْمَاقُ ٱلْمِيَاهِ، وَٱنْكَشَفَتْ أُسُسُ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ مِنْ زَجْرِكَ يَارَبُّ، مِنْ نَسْمَةِ رِيحِ أَنْفِكَ.
verses.kjv: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.web: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ مِنَ ٱلْعُلَى فَأَخَذَنِي. نَشَلَنِي مِنْ مِيَاهٍ كَثِيرَةٍ.
verses.kjv: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.web: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

verses.ar: أَنْقَذَنِي مِنْ عَدُوِّي ٱلْقَوِيِّ، وَمِنْ مُبْغِضِيَّ لِأَنَّهُمْ أَقْوَى مِنِّي.
verses.kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.web: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

verses.ar: أَصَابُونِي فِي يَوْمِ بَلِيَّتِي، وَكَانَ ٱلرَّبُّ سَنَدِي.
verses.kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
verses.web: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

verses.ar: أَخْرَجَنِي إِلَى ٱلرُّحْبِ. خَلَّصَنِي لِأَنَّهُ سُرَّ بِي.
verses.kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.web: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.ar: يُكَافِئُنِي ٱلرَّبُّ حَسَبَ بِرِّي. حَسَبَ طَهَارَةِ يَدَيَّ يَرُدُّ لِي.
verses.kjv: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.web: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي حَفِظْتُ طُرُقَ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَلَمْ أَعْصِ إِلَهِي.
verses.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.web: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ جَمِيعَ أَحْكَامِهِ أَمَامِي، وَفَرَائِضَهُ لَمْ أُبْعِدْهَا عَنْ نَفْسِي.
verses.kjv: For all his judgments [were] before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.web: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

verses.ar: وَأَكُونُ كَامِلًا مَعَهُ وَأَتَحَفَّظُ مِنْ إِثْمِي.
verses.kjv: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.web: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

verses.ar: فَيَرُدُّ ٱلرَّبُّ لِي كَبِرِّي، وَكَطَهَارَةِ يَدَيَّ أَمَامَ عَيْنَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.web: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

verses.ar: مَعَ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَكُونُ رَحِيمًا. مَعَ ٱلرَّجُلِ ٱلْكَامِلِ تَكُونُ كَامِلًا.
verses.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
verses.web: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

verses.ar: مَعَ ٱلطَّاهِرِ تَكُونُ طَاهِرًا، وَمَعَ ٱلْأَعْوَجِ تَكُونُ مُلْتَوِيًا.
verses.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
verses.web: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ تُخَلِّصُ ٱلشَّعْبَ ٱلْبَائِسَ، وَٱلْأَعْيُنُ ٱلْمُرْتَفِعَةُ تَضَعُهَا.
verses.kjv: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.web: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ تُضِيءُ سِرَاجِي. ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهِي يُنِيرُ ظُلْمَتِي.
verses.kjv: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.web: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي بِكَ ٱقْتَحَمْتُ جَيْشًا، وَبِإِلَهِي تَسَوَّرْتُ أَسْوَارًا.
verses.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.web: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

verses.ar: ٱللهُ طَرِيقُهُ كَامِلٌ. قَوْلُ ٱلرَّبِّ نَقِيٌّ. تُرْسٌ هُوَ لِجَمِيعِ ٱلْمُحْتَمِينَ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: [As for] God, his way [is] perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he [is] a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.web: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ ٱلرَّبِّ؟ وَمَنْ هُوَ صَخْرَةٌ سِوَى إِلَهِنَا؟
verses.kjv: For who [is] God save the LORD? or who [is] a rock save our God?
verses.web: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

verses.ar: ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلَّذِي يُمَنْطِقُنِي بِٱلْقُوَّةِ وَيُصَيِّرُ طَرِيقِي كَامِلًا.
verses.kjv: [It is] God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
verses.web: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي يَجْعَلُ رِجْلَيَّ كَٱلْإِيَّلِ، وَعَلَى مُرْتَفِعَاتِي يُقِيمُنِي.
verses.kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ [feet], and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.web: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي يُعَلِّمُ يَدَيَّ ٱلْقِتَالَ، فَتُحْنَى بِذِرَاعَيَّ قَوْسٌ مِنْ نُحَاسٍ.
verses.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.web: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

verses.ar: وَتَجْعَلُ لِي تُرْسَ خَلَاصِكَ وَيَمِينُكَ تَعْضُدُنِي، وَلُطْفُكَ يُعَظِّمُنِي.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.web: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

verses.ar: تُوَسِّعُ خُطُوَاتِي تَحْتِي، فَلَمْ تَتَقَلْقَلْ عَقِبَايَ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.web: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

verses.ar: أَتْبَعُ أَعْدَائِي فَأُدْرِكُهُمْ، وَلَا أَرْجِعُ حَتَّى أُفْنِيَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.web: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

verses.ar: أَسْحَقُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ٱلْقِيَامَ. يَسْقُطُونَ تَحْتَ رِجْلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.web: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

verses.ar: تُمَنْطِقُنِي بِقُوَّةٍ لِلْقِتَالِ. تَصْرَعُ تَحْتِي ٱلْقَائِمِينَ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.web: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

verses.ar: وَتُعْطِينِي أَقْفِيَةَ أَعْدَائِي، وَمُبْغِضِيَّ أُفْنِيهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

verses.ar: يَصْرُخُونَ وَلَا مُخَلِّصَ. إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فَلَا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: They cried, but [there was] none to save [them: even] unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
verses.web: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

verses.ar: فَأَسْحَقُهُمْ كَٱلْغُبَارِ قُدَّامَ ٱلرِّيحِ. مِثْلَ طِينِ ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ أَطْرَحُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.web: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

verses.ar: تُنْقِذُنِي مِنْ مُخَاصَمَاتِ ٱلشَّعْبِ. تَجْعَلُنِي رَأْسًا لِلْأُمَمِ. شَعْبٌ لَمْ أَعْرِفْهُ يَتَعَبَّدُ لِي.
verses.kjv: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; [and] thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people [whom] I have not known shall serve me.
verses.web: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

verses.ar: مِنْ سَمَاعِ ٱلْأُذُنِ يَسْمَعُونَ لِي. بَنُو ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ يَتَذَلَّلُونَ لِي.
verses.kjv: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.web: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

verses.ar: بَنُو ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ يَبْلَوْنَ وَيَزْحَفُونَ مِنْ حُصُونِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.web: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

verses.ar: حَيٌّ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ، وَمُبَارَكٌ صَخْرَتِي، وَمُرْتَفِعٌ إِلَهُ خَلَاصِي،
verses.kjv: The LORD liveth; and blessed [be] my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.web: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

verses.ar: ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلْمُنْتَقِمُ لِي، وَٱلَّذِي يُخْضِعُ ٱلشُّعُوبَ تَحْتِي.
verses.kjv: [It is] God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.web: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

verses.ar: مُنَجِّيَّ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي. رَافِعِي أَيْضًا فَوْقَ ٱلْقَائِمِينَ عَلَيَّ. مِنَ ٱلرَّجُلِ ٱلظَّالِمِ تُنْقِذُنِي.
verses.kjv: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.web: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ أَحْمَدُكَ يَارَبُّ فِي ٱلْأُمَمِ، وَأُرَنِّمُ لِٱسْمِكَ.
verses.kjv: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
verses.web: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

verses.ar: بُرْجُ خَلَاصٍ لِمَلِكِهِ، وَٱلصَّانِعُ رَحْمَةً لِمَسِيحِهِ، لِدَاوُدَ وَنَسْلِهِ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
